site_intro: 23 agent designs for Pamplin faculty, derived from what came up at the May 7 AI Teaching Workshop. Pick a recipe, copy the fields into your platform of choice, build the agent in 15-90 minutes.
tutorial_section_intro: New to building agents? Start here.

family_descriptions.in_class_activity_engines: Agents that drive the dynamic things that happen in class — roleplays, debates, group exercises, structured activities.
family_descriptions.student_facing_always_on: Agents you build once and students use throughout the semester. Higher build effort, much higher leverage per build.
family_descriptions.discussion_case_method: Agents that help with case-method teaching and discussion-based formats.
family_descriptions.course_architecture: Agents that help you redesign or restructure a course at the syllabus / module / format level.
family_descriptions.assessment_feedback: Agents that help with rubrics, formative checks, and feedback voice.
family_descriptions.examples_cases_content: Agents that generate teaching content — examples, cases, multi-perspective explanations.
family_descriptions.ai_policy: Agents that help you draft AI-use policy for your course.
